title: Trapping √90
caption: 9.4² = 88.36 is below 90 and 9.5² = 90.25 is just above, so √90 lies between 9.4 and 9.5, very close to 9.5: √90 ≈ 9.5 to one decimal place.
alt: A number line from 9 to 10 with marks at 9.4 and 9.5 and a point for √90 just left of 9.5.
description: The line runs from 9 to 10, since 81 < 90 < 100.
9.4 squared is 88.36, too small; 9.5 squared is 90.25, just too big.
So √90 ≈ 9.487 sits just left of 9.5 and rounds to 9.5.
